history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: The essence of the Argentine Sea
history.p1: At From Patagonia, our essence is the Argentine Sea. We are a family-owned historic company dedicated to the extraction, processing and export of fish and seafood with decades of experience, integrating the entire value chain: from capture in our cold crystalline waters to global logistics ensuring the product reaches international markets in absolute freshness conditions.
history.p2: We operate with our own fleet, process at our Mar del Plata and Trelew plants with the highest sanitary standards, and our brand and industry are synonymous with total traceability throughout the entire production circuit. We export the richness of our coasts to the world, with the seriousness and commitment that the most demanding markets require.
history.p3: Well-known Argentine companies in the global market entrust their productions to us because we have extensive experience in this!!

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.quote: "To consolidate ourselves as the undisputed benchmark in the export of Argentine Sea products globally, maintaining the excellence in quality, traceability and sustainability that characterizes us."

langostinos.name: SHRIMP
langostinos.desc: Our Patagonian Shrimp (Pleoticus muelleri) is the jewel of the Argentine Sea. Caught by our own fleet in the cold, pristine waters of Patagonia and processed with the highest standards of quality and food safety, it is available in a wide variety of presentations: whole frozen on board or on land, tails, peeled and deveined. Its intense flavor and firm texture make it the preferred choice of the most demanding international markets.

langostino-bordo.name: Shrimp processed on board
langostino-bordo.desc: The excellence of on-board frozen shrimp lies in its immediacy. Caught in national waters, it is sorted and frozen on the same vessel within minutes of being caught. This process eliminates the land transport chain, allowing the product to keep all its organoleptic qualities intact from the sea to the final carton. It is, by definition, a product of absolute freshness caught at its optimum point.

langostino-tierra.name: Shrimp processed on land
langostino-tierra.desc: Our fresh seasonal shrimp is caught by our fresh fish fleet and transported daily to our plants in Trelew, ensuring an uninterrupted cold chain. Here, a specialized team performs custom processing according to your requirements: from headless to precise peeling and deveining. Each piece is carefully sorted and frozen following rigorous food safety controls to guarantee a ready-to-use product with export quality.

merluza.name: HAKE
merluza.desc: Our Southern Hake (Merluccius hubbsi) comes from FAO Zone 41, with 7-10 day trips (Mar del Plata fleet) or 2-3 days (Comodoro Rivadavia fleet) that guarantee unparalleled freshness. Upon arrival at port, the fish is transferred under a strict cold chain to our processing plants (Mar del Plata or Trelew). There, automatic heading and gutting is performed with the highest hygiene standards, followed by precise size grading and ultra-fast freezing that preserves texture and natural properties.

merluza-entera-hg.name: Whole hake and HG/HGT
merluza-entera-hg.desc: Our Southern Hake comes from our fleet caught in FAO Zone 41, with 7 to 10 day trips (Mar del Plata fleet) or 2 to 3 days (Comodoro Rivadavia fleet) guaranteeing unparalleled freshness. Upon arrival at port, the fish is transferred under a strict cold chain to our processing plants (Mar del Plata or Trelew). There, automatic heading and gutting is performed with the highest hygiene standards, followed by precise size grading and ultra-fast freezing that preserves the texture and natural properties.

v.1: HG or HGT 80/200 GRS (Block / Interleaved 10 kg, bag 1-10 kg)

merluza-filet.name: Hake fillet
merluza-filet.desc: Our hake fillet is synonymous with precision and care. After reception at the plant, expert filleters perform the cutting ensuring the integrity of each piece. Our process includes a key stage of sanitary control and manual deparasitizing, ensuring a product of maximum purity. Sorted by size and packed at origin, our fillet is instantly frozen to reach your table maintaining its premium quality.
